```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
# library(tidyplots) # Removed, theme_pander() is in ggthemes
# library(ggridges)  # Removed, no clear usage
library(patchwork)
# library(DT)         # Removed, knitr::kable is used
library(viridis)
# library(readr)     # Removed, part of tidyverse
# library(here)      # Removed, no clear usage
library(showtext)
library(knitr)
library(ggthemes)

# Set up FontAwesome
# Check if fonts directory exists directly or in assets/fonts
if (dir.exists("fonts")) {
  font_add('FontAwesome', 'fonts/fontawesome-webfont.ttf')
} else if (dir.exists("assets/fonts")) {
  font_add('FontAwesome', 'assets/fonts/fontawesome-webfont.ttf')
} else {
  warning("Font directory not found. FontAwesome not available.")
}
showtext_auto()

# Helper function to create nicer labels
nice_label <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title()
}

# Custom theme function for consistent plot styling
custom_theme <- function() {
  theme_pander() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 10, l = 5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.2)
    )
}

```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: load-data

# test params$patient_id
# assing 10003_10003 as test
# params = list(patient_id = "10003")

# Set paths
score_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "pgs.txt", full.names = FALSE)
popsim_files <- list.files(".", pattern = "popsimilarity.txt", full.names = FALSE)

# Load score data
scores <- read_tsv(file.path(score_files))

# Load popsim data
popsim <- read_tsv(file.path(popsim_files))

# Get basic stats
n_scores <- length(unique(scores$PGS))
n_samples <- length(unique(scores$IID))

# Create comprehensive run_patient_data with all necessary variables
scores_popsim <- scores %>%
  left_join(popsim %>% select(IID, MostSimilarPop), by = "IID") %>% 
  # Create a simple ID column using the last part after underscore
  mutate(simple_id = str_extract(IID, "[^_]+$"))

# Calculate percentiles for each PGS score separately
scores_popsim <- scores_popsim %>%
  group_by(PGS) %>%
  mutate(Overall_Percentile = round(percent_rank(Z_MostSimilarPop) * 100, 1)) %>%
  group_by(PGS, MostSimilarPop) %>%
  mutate(Population_Percentile = round(percent_rank(Z_MostSimilarPop) * 100, 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

run_patient_data <- scores_popsim %>%
  filter(sampleset != "reference") %>%
  head(64) # FIXME: should not matter, no more than 64 patients in the reference set should be present

# Get reference data
reference_data <- scores_popsim %>% filter(sampleset == "reference")

# Look up full IID from simple ID
full_patient_id <- scores_popsim %>%
  filter(simple_id == params$patient_id) %>%
  pull(IID) %>%
  first()

if (is.na(full_patient_id)) {
  stop("Patient ID not found")
}

# Get all PGS scores for this patient
patient_pgs_scores <- scores_popsim %>%
  filter(IID == full_patient_id) %>%
  pull(PGS) %>%
  unique()

# Save summary data to CSV
patient_summary_all <- scores_popsim %>%
  filter(IID == full_patient_id) %>%
  select(IID, PGS, Z_MostSimilarPop, Overall_Percentile, Population_Percentile)

write_csv(patient_summary_all, "patient_summaries.csv")
```

```{r functions, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: functions

# Function to create patient risk visualization with human icons
create_patient_risk_viz <- function(patient_id, pgs_id = NULL, by_ancestry = FALSE) {
  # Get patient data, filtered by PGS if provided
  filtered_data <- if (!is.null(pgs_id)) {
    scores_popsim %>% filter(PGS == pgs_id)
  } else {
    scores_popsim
  }
  
  if(nrow(filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id)) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "Patient not found") + 
           theme_void())
  }

  if(by_ancestry) {
    patient_percentile <- filtered_data %>%
      filter(IID == full_patient_id) %>%
      pull(Population_Percentile)
  } else {
    patient_percentile <- filtered_data %>%
      filter(IID == full_patient_id) %>%
      pull(Overall_Percentile)
  }
  
  # Create grid positions (10 rows x 10 columns)
  n_rows <- 10
  n_cols <- 10
  grid_positions <- expand.grid(
    row = 1:n_rows,
    col = 1:n_cols
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      percentile_range = case_when(
        row == 1 ~ "0-10",
        row == 10 ~ "91-100",
        TRUE ~ paste0(((row - 1) * 10 + 1), "-", (row * 10))
      ),
      row_start = (row - 1) * 10,
      row_end = row * 10,
      is_patient_row = patient_percentile > row_start & patient_percentile <= row_end
    )
  
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(grid_positions, aes(x = col, y = row, color = is_patient_row)) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = n_cols + 1.2,
      xend = n_cols + 1.2,
      y = 1,
      yend = n_rows,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "last"),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      label = "\uf007",
      family = "FontAwesome",
      size = 5,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray80", "TRUE" = "#3366CC")) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = 1:n_rows,
      labels = c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-40", "41-50", 
                "51-60", "61-70", "71-80", "81-90", "91-100"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))  # Increased expansion to provide more space
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15)),
      limits = c(0.5, n_cols + 1.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = if(by_ancestry) "Within Ancestry Group" else "Overall Population",
      subtitle = paste0(round(patient_percentile, 1), "th percentile"),
      y = "Percentile Range",
      x = NULL
    ) +
    theme_pander() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.2)
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = n_cols + 1.5,
      y = n_rows,
      label = "higher\nrisk",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = n_cols + 1.5,
      y = 1,
      label = "lower\nrisk",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) 
}

# Function to create density plot for a patient
create_density_plot <- function(patient_id, pgs_id = NULL) {
  # Filter data by PGS if provided
  filtered_data <- if (!is.null(pgs_id)) {
    scores_popsim %>% filter(PGS == pgs_id)
  } else {
    scores_popsim
  }
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_density(
      data = filtered_data,
      aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop),
      fill = "gray80",
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_density(
      data = filtered_data,
      aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, color = MostSimilarPop),
      alpha = 0.8,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id),
      aes(xintercept = Z_MostSimilarPop),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id),
      aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = max(density(filtered_data$Z_MostSimilarPop)$y) * 0.9, 
          label = paste("Patient", params$patient_id)),
      color = "red",
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of PGS Scores by Ancestry Group",
      x = "Z-Score (Most Similar Population)",
      y = "Density",
      color = "Ancestry Group"
    ) +
    custom_theme() +
    scale_color_viridis_d()
}

# function to create a histogram of the PGS score
# histogram + density lines, signal patient data point. 
create_histogram_density_plot <- function(patient_id, pgs_id = NULL) {
  # Filter data by PGS if provided
  filtered_data <- if (!is.null(pgs_id)) {
    scores_popsim %>% filter(PGS == pgs_id)
  } else {
    scores_popsim
  }
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add vertical line for patient
  geom_vline(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id),
    aes(xintercept = Z_MostSimilarPop),
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # Add text annotation for patient
  geom_text(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id),
    aes(x = Z_MostSimilarPop, y = max(density(filtered_data$Z_MostSimilarPop)$y) * 0.8, 
        label = paste("Patient", patient_id)),
    color = "red",
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of PGS Scores",
    subtitle = "Patient highlighted in red",
    x = "Z-Score (Most Similar Population)",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  custom_theme()
}

# boxplot of the PGS score with patient placement
create_boxplot <- function(patient_id, pgs_id = NULL) {
  # Filter data by PGS if provided
  filtered_data <- if (!is.null(pgs_id)) {
    scores_popsim %>% filter(PGS == pgs_id)
  } else {
    scores_popsim
  }
  
  ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = PGS, y = Z_MostSimilarPop)) +
    # Add boxplot
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  # Highlight patient point
  geom_point(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(IID == full_patient_id),
    size = 4,
    shape = 17,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  # Add mean line
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.5,
    size = 0.5,
    color = "darkblue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PGS Score Distribution",
    subtitle = paste("Patient", patient_id, "highlighted in red"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "PGS Score (Z_MostSimilarPop)"
  ) +
  custom_theme()
}

```

# Overall Summary

```{r overall-summary, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Display summary of all PGS scores for this patient
patient_summary_table <- scores_popsim %>%
  filter(IID == full_patient_id) %>%
  select(PGS, Z_MostSimilarPop, Overall_Percentile, Population_Percentile) %>%
  rename(
    "Score Type" = PGS,
    "Score" = Z_MostSimilarPop,
    "Overall Percentile" = Overall_Percentile,
    "Ancestry Percentile" = Population_Percentile
  )

# For HTML output, use kable
knitr::kable(patient_summary_table, format = "html", digits = 2, align = "c", 
             caption = paste("Summary of all PGS scores for Patient", params$patient_id))
```

```{r generate-sections, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Loop through each PGS score and create a section for it
for (pgs_id in patient_pgs_scores) {
  # Create section header
  cat("\n\n# Analysis for PGS Score:", pgs_id, "\n\n")
  
  # Create patient summary subsection for this specific PGS
  cat("## Patient Summary for", pgs_id, "\n\n")
  
  # Display patient summary for this score in a table
  patient_score_summary <- scores_popsim %>%
    filter(IID == full_patient_id, PGS == pgs_id) %>%
    select(Z_MostSimilarPop, Overall_Percentile, Population_Percentile) %>%
    rename(
      "Score" = Z_MostSimilarPop,
      "Overall Percentile" = Overall_Percentile,
      "Ancestry Percentile" = Population_Percentile
    )
  
  # Print summary table for this score with HTML formatting
  print(knitr::kable(patient_score_summary, format = "html", digits = 2, align = "c"))
  
  # Risk visualization section
  cat("\n\n## Risk Visualization for", pgs_id, "\n\n")
  
  # Create both risk visualization plots for this score
  p1 <- create_patient_risk_viz(params$patient_id, pgs_id, by_ancestry = TRUE)
  p2 <- create_patient_risk_viz(params$patient_id, pgs_id, by_ancestry = FALSE)
  
  # Combine plots with patchwork
  combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
    plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste("Risk Percentile for", pgs_id),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18))
    )
  
  print(combined_plot)
  
  # Score distribution section
  cat("\n\n## Score Distribution for", pgs_id, "\n\n")
  
  # Create and print boxplot
  cat("### Boxplot of scores\n\n")
  print(create_boxplot(params$patient_id, pgs_id))
  
  # Create and print histogram
  cat("### Score histogram\n\n")
  print(create_histogram_density_plot(params$patient_id, pgs_id))
  
  # Create and print density plot
  cat("### Score distribution by ancestry\n\n")
  print(create_density_plot(params$patient_id, pgs_id))
}
``` 
